headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2025: Babes Of Wrath vs. Timeless Love Bombs etched their names into history in the first-ever AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.54. In the tournament final to crown the first-ever AEW Women's World Tag Team Champions, Babes of Wrath (Nightingale and Cameron) defeated Timeless Love Bombs (Storm and Shirakawa), with even the losing team joining the celebration afterward in a rare show of sportsmanship.

Turning the clock back to 2021: Rey Fenix reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing The Lucha Brothers vs. FTR, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 7.99 ? a match that delivered in a physical tag team battle.

2025 brought us this moment: the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Samoa Joe vs. Eddie Kingston went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.56 ? a solid showing. Samoa Joe was chasing gold for the 10th time. Samoa Joe defended his newly won AEW World Championship against Eddie Kingston.
